articles.summary: September 2025 marks West Fraser’s 70th anniversary — a milestone that honours the hard work and determination of our founders, Sam, Bill and Pete Ketcham, and the group of trailblazing employees who built something enduring. What began in 1955 as a 12-person planer mill in Quesnel has grown into one of the world’s leading forest products businesses. Yet the foundation remains the same: a belief in hard work, partnership and continuous improvement.
articles.title: How the West Fraser Story Began
